name: Trellis: Sproutify Home Daily App Store Downloads

parameters.content:
## Sproutify Home only · inactive until approved

App Apple ID: 6478242429. Runs daily at 16:25 UTC.

Select the existing Trellis HTTP Header Auth refresh credential: header x-trellis-refresh-secret, value from server-side POSTHOG_REFRESH_SECRET. Never paste the value into this file.

Confirm the app-store-analytics function, schema and ASC credentials are ready, run one manual import, inspect Sproutify Home results, then activate only with authorization. The validation node fails executions for per-app failures even when HTTP status is 207. See docs/APP_STORE_ANALYTICS.md.
